elements.name: pale gravel road winding along steep mountainsides
one tiny country bus on the road
long dust plume trailing the bus
layers of mountains fading into blue haze

wrong_setting: The forest is uniformly pine/fir-like conifers with no eucalyptus, which reads more like a generic Alpine or Mediterranean pine range than the Ethiopian highlands.
notes: Mix tall pale-barked eucalyptus stands in among the conifers to sell the Ethiopian highlands, and keep the dust plume hugging the road instead of drifting up across the open slope to the right.
